recommendations.problem: A pause on cartservice caused Cart, Home, Product to fail
recommendations.fix: Give callers a short client timeout and a retry/circuit-breaker so a hung dependency fails fast instead of tying up connections (timeouts live in the caller's code, so this needs an upstream change; a Compose `healthcheck` with `depends_on: condition: service_healthy` mitigates it meanwhile).
recommendations.expected_effect: removes or reduces the failure a pause on cartservice caused

attack.reason: verify the fix for pause on cartservice

verification.success_criteria: re-run this attack; the fix works if the previously-failed pages stay up, the peak error rate stays under the abort threshold, and recovery is no slower than before

recommendations.problem: A stop on redis-cart caused a aborted verdict
recommendations.fix: Evidence is thin. Before changing anything, re-run a stop on redis-cart with logging on to confirm the failure mode. Candidate fix: Run a second replica of this service (compose `deploy.replicas: 2` behind the frontend's client-side load balancing), or add a graceful fallback so its outage does not fail the page.
